relations.reading: Readiness depends on evidence remaining valid and actionable within the operating decision window.

relations.title: Aprendizaje interno repetible
relations.reading: The industrialization case describes quality-system and audit-readiness work that can illustrate observable maturity practices without claiming a certified maturity level.

relations.title: Admisibilidad contextual
relations.reading: Evidence reuse across audits should carry purpose, scope, version and access conditions, so a reusable record does not become an unrestricted or context-free assertion.

relations.title: Suficiencia para una decisión
relations.reading: A completed checklist is not a global sufficiency theorem; the requirement-conformance analysis preserves the exact implications that remain unclosed.
